acceptance_criteria: Every scene has a distinct story role and reads as SkyyRose without its logo.
Customers and exact products remain the primary focal hierarchy at commerce-readable scale.
Every scene defines output geometry, camera, horizon, contact points, light, shadow, floor, reflection, grain, depth, and occlusion requirements.
Urban grit comes from real material behavior and place-specific visual language, not generic warehouse props or distressed overlays.
Every protected garment, customer identity, wordmark, and sculpture remains bound to an approved source hash.
No paid execution can start without current source checks, prompt assertion PASS, explicit candidate-bound approval, and a one-attempt budget envelope.
A rejected or mutated candidate cannot be retried automatically or used as the next generation input.
